name: Flux 2 Klein 4B Prompt-Guided Image Edit
description: Prompt-guided image edit using Flux 2 + reference-latent conditioning. Note: this workflow samples from an empty latent, so denoise=0 will look like a blank/gray image. For classic img2img variations (latent-init), use flux_2_klein_4B_variations.
use_cases: Modify an existing image while preserving composition.
Increase output resolution while retaining style.
